name: Soléi Desert Retreat
blurb: Where the desert meets the sky - intimate 6-room retreat with panoramic pool
description: Where golden sands whisper stories of peace — Soléi Desert Retreat invites you to reconnect with nature. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets, a serene pool, and authentic Siwan hospitality in a secluded desert haven.

name: Adrère Amellal
blurb: World-famous earth-brick ecolodge facing a shimmering salt lake
description: Built entirely from salt rock and clay by hand, this legendary ecolodge offers an authentic desert experience without sacrificing luxury. Wake to sunrise over the salt lake and dine by candlelight under star-filled skies.

name: Soléi Siwa Sanctuary
blurb: Contemporary desert retreat blending modern luxury with ancient wisdom
description: Our flagship Siwa property combines modern amenities with traditional desert architecture. Experience world-class wellness treatments using ancient Egyptian healing methods in a contemporary luxury setting.

name: Talist Eco Lodge
blurb: Sustainable palm grove hideaway with solar power and organic gardens
description: Nestled in ancient palm groves, this eco-friendly lodge operates entirely on solar power. Enjoy organic meals from the on-site garden while staying in beautifully crafted mud-brick accommodations.

name: Desert Rose Camp
blurb: Luxury desert camping under the clearest night skies in Egypt
description: Experience the romance of desert camping with luxury amenities. Each tent features comfortable bedding, private bathrooms, and unobstructed views of the Milky Way in one of the world's darkest sky areas.

name: Shali Lodge
blurb: Historic lodge built within the ancient ruins of Shali fortress
description: Stay within the ancient walls of Shali, the 13th-century fortress that once protected Siwa. This unique lodge preserves historical architecture while offering modern comfort and cultural immersion.

name: Salt Lake Wellness Resort
blurb: Healing-focused resort specializing in salt therapy and wellness retreats
description: Dedicated to holistic healing using Siwa's natural mineral-rich environment. Specializes in salt therapy, meditation retreats, and detoxification programs using ancient Egyptian wellness traditions.
